dedupe_keys.name: sea bright nj reconstruction of hurricane sandy agent based model of homeowner flood damage and reconstruction decisions mason

description: This agent-based model reconstructs the damage Hurricane Sandy caused in the coastal borough of Sea Bright, New Jersey, and the reconstruction choices homeowners made afterwards. The CoMSES Net release read on 2026-09-28 (version 1.0.0, published 20 March 2021 by Kim McEligot) describes homeowner agents whose decisions about hazard mitigation combine the Protective Action Decision Model and Protection Motivation Theory, implemented in Java on the MASON simulation framework, and states that the hind-cast was validated against FEMA damage assessments and post-storm surveys. Coverage is one New Jersey barrier island town. Access is free download under the MIT licence. Caveats: it is a single-author research model with few downloads and no peer review badge, and input data provenance is only summarised. It supports post-event and recovery studies of residential building stock, such as testing how elevation or rebuilding choices change exposure to the next storm. No related Sea Bright or Sandy reconstruction record is catalogued.
name: Sea Bright, NJ reconstruction of Hurricane Sandy: agent-based model of homeowner flood damage and reconstruction decisions (MASON)
